meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE (DGCI&S data)
meta.coverage: India's merchandise exports, imports and trade balance each month since April 1990, with oil and non-oil since April 1997, ₹ crore
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 648 (totals) and 425 (oil and non-oil), DGCI&S data as republished by the RBI, in rupees. In February and March 2017 the oil split is an earlier print than the total and does not add to it, and the June 2001 balance is printed as -1,970 crore against exports minus imports of -1,904; both shown as published. meta.revision names the version of each month.
